## 1. Problem and outcome

Who is affected? What should change? What is out of scope?

## 2. Spec and acceptance

Rules and assumptions, plus one happy path and one exception in Given/When/Then.

## 3. Handoffs and evidence

Systems, people, dependencies and test data. What proves it works?

## 4. Improvements and unknowns

What would catch a gap earlier? Open questions, and the measures to baseline.
